question: In a sequence $a_1,a_2,\ldots$ of real numbers it is observed that $a_p=\sqrt2$, $a_q=\sqrt3$ and $a_r=\sqrt5$, where $1\le p<q<r$ are positive integers. Then $a_p,a_q,a_r$ can be terms of

options.C: an arithmetic progression if and only if $p,q,r$ are perfect squares
options.D: neither an arithmetic progression nor a harmonic progression

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
